entries.original_title: Discovery and preclinical validation of drug indications using compendia of public gene expression data
entries.original_authors: Sirota, Matthew; Dudley, Joel; Kim, Jae; Chiang, Arnold; Morgan, Alex; Sweet-Cordero, Arnaldo; Sage, Julian; Butte, Atul
entries.description: The original study claimed that cimetidine treatment reduced tumor volume in A549 human lung adenocarcinoma xenografts compared with vehicle control; this replication tested the claim in the A549 xenograft experiment.
entries.citation_sentence: This experiment is similar to what was reported in Figure 4C–D and Supplemental Figure 1 of Sirota et al., 2011.
entries.notes: The replication effect was in the expected direction but did not reach the preregistered Bonferroni-adjusted significance threshold; the authors describe it as consistent in direction and the meta-analysis was significant.

entries.original_title: Discovery and preclinical validation of drug indications using compendia of public gene expression data
entries.original_authors: Sirota, Matthew; Dudley, Joel; Kim, Jae; Chiang, Arnold; Morgan, Alex; Sweet-Cordero, Arnaldo; Sage, Julian; Butte, Atul
entries.description: The original study claimed that cimetidine treatment did not change tumor volume in ACHN renal cell carcinoma xenografts compared with vehicle control, demonstrating specificity for lung adenocarcinoma; this replication tested the claim in the ACHN xenograft experiment.
entries.citation_sentence: This experiment is similar to what was reported in Figure 4C–D and Supplemental Figure 1 of Sirota et al., 2011.
entries.notes: The original was a genuine null claim for ACHN tumors, and the replication also found no observational or statistically significant treatment difference; the authors state this was similar to the original study.
